questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Academic opportunities

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: De valgfag som universitet tilbød var vigtige for mig. Jeg synes at Visuel Antropologi var spændende og University of Manchester er et af de førende universiteter indenfor det, hvorfor jeg valgte der primært af den grund.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: Det var forholdsvis nemt.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: Ikke meget, fik en del mails fra universitetet, men hele deres system var nede den første tid jeg var der, hvilket både gjorde det svært at vurdere mine fag og se mit skema, samt andet information, men lige så snart kurserne var gået i gang, var det nemt og professorerne var hjælpsomme.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing through my host institution

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: On campus

questions.question: What options were available for on campus housing? *
questions.answer: Der var studenthalls som man kunne søge. Her var kvaliteten meget forskellig og jeg valgt primært det billigste som var tættest på uni.

questions.question: What options were available for meal plans or cooking facilities? *
questions.answer: Det kom an på, hvilket student hall man valgte. Jeg valgte et hvor man selv skulle lave mad, hvilket jeg satte pris på.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about on campus housing? *
questions.answer: At det er en nem måde at komme i kontakt med andre ved at bo med andre, men at faciliteterne ikke er specielt gode.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: Det må jeg være ærlig at sige, at det kan jeg ikke huske så meget om.

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: Man kunne dog altid kontakte administrationen og så kunne de hjælpe.

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Meget, var heldig og fik nogle virkelig fede fag.

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Ikke stress over der, der er en 2 ugers prøveperiode, så hvis du ikke er tilfreds med dit tilvalgte fag kan du sagtens skifte.

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: BA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA courses at your host university? *
questions.answer: Both

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: To af de fag jeg tog blev udbudt som valgfag både for BA og MA.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: Det var meget det samme, i hvert fald de fag jeg havde på antropologi. Jeg havde dog også et fag på pædagogik, hvor jeg oplevede et meget lav niveau fra mine medstuderendes side. Ellers var forelæsningerne typisk 2 timer og seminar 1 time.

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: Please list the courses you were enrolled in during your first semester. *
questions.answer: Equity in Education, Screening Culture og Anthropology of vision, senses and memory.

questions.question: What specific courses would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Ville klart anbefale Screening Culture og Anthropology of vision, senses and memory til andre antropologistuderende som har interesse i visuel antropologi. Begge spændende fag med fede undervisere.

What unexpected costs did you encounter? *
questions.answer: Tror ikke jeg havde nogle, vidste godt at jeg ikke ville komme til at tjene penge men kun bruge dem i et halvt år...

questions.question: What items were more or less expensive than you expected? *
questions.answer: Det var billigere at gå på cafe end jeg havde regnet med

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Alle mulige, der var et societies fair da jeg ankom, hvor man kunne deltage og få information og lige hvad man ville. Dog vil jeg dog sige at det er svært at deltage i sport, hvis man kun er der et semester fordi de har udtagelser til hold. Men man kunne sagtens deltage i mindre forpligtende sport.

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Snakke med dem i sin lejlighed

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Jeg tog til Skotland i min Reading Week hvilket var kæmpe fedt!

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Det var ikke svært, men kiggede stadig den forkerte vej hver gang jeg gik over vejen efter 5 måneder.

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Tal med din sidemakker i pausen til undervisningen. De er typisk søde!

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: ikke rigtig nogle

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Uh, deres høflighed

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Hvis du flytter ind i student halls, så er der ingenting, så hvis det er muligt tag dyne med hjemmefra, og så find noget billigt service og køkkengrej.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Jeg følte jeg blev meget mere selvsikker i at tale engelsk

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: Jeg synes ikke at man må underkende at der er hårdt at flytte til en ny by, hvor man ikke kender nogen og væk fra alt man har kært. Med det sagt kommer der nye relationer og rutiner som er anderledes og fede!!

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
